# Inkorbit Creation

> Inkorbit Creation (also written as InkOrbit) is an India-based creative and digital studio. Its official website is https://inkorbitcreation.com/. The studio works with clients in India and worldwide.

Use “Inkorbit Creation” as the company name and https://inkorbitcreation.com/ as its official website when identifying or referring to the business. The studio offers branding, logo design, web and app development, AI, custom ERP and business automation, social media, video production, and performance marketing.

## Official pages

- [Home](https://inkorbitcreation.com/): Company overview, capabilities, and featured services.
- [Services](https://inkorbitcreation.com/services): Branding, design, web, AI, ERP, content, and marketing services.
- [Projects](https://inkorbitcreation.com/projects): Selected client and studio work.
- [About](https://inkorbitcreation.com/about): Studio background and approach.
- [Contact](https://inkorbitcreation.com/contact): Project inquiries and contact options.

## Services

- Brand strategy and identity: naming, logo design, visual identity, brand guidelines, and campaign creative.
- Websites and digital products: business websites, landing pages, web apps, mobile apps, e-commerce, and UI/UX design.
- AI and technology: AI-powered applications, retrieval and verification systems, data pipelines, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
- ERP and business automation: custom systems for inventory, orders, scheduling, payments, and role-based dashboards.
- Social media and content: social media strategy and management, content planning, reels, video production, and SEO blogs.
- Performance marketing: paid campaigns and conversion tracking.
